lego-pokemon-go-2026@pokemon-go-calendar.details:
The Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership continues for Trainers in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia! Visit participating LEGO Store locations for raids, a LEGO-themed stamp rally, event stickers, and LEGO Pokémon SMART Play.
The LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO event will take place from August 3, 2026 at 10 am to September 30, 2026 at 11 pm.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Participating LEGO Store Locations
You can use this interactive map to find participating stores near you. This list is from the official Stamp Rally map.
The interactive map will load when it is near the screen.
Open the official map

▸ Stamp Rally
Take part in a special LEGO-themed stamp rally during the event! A stamp rally is an activity where you collect stamps at certain PokéStops and Gyms. Explore participating LEGO Stores and find designated stops to collect stamps, which leads to encounters with Pikachu that have a Special Background.
Stamps can be collected at select LEGO Stores in Australia, France, Great Britain, Germany, Poland, and the United States.
Trainers can start the stamp rally by visiting a participating LEGO Store until September 30, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. local time.

▸ How stamp rallies work
Orange stamp icons will be displayed above the PokéStops included in the stamp rally. When you tap on these PokéStops, the stamp sheet will appear so you can collect your stamp.
You can view the stamps you collect on the stamp rally page in your Scrapbook. Certain stamp rallies also let you send stamps to your friends along with a Gift. Stamps you get from Gifts will be collected in your Scrapbook, but they don’t count toward the reward track. Rewards can only be obtained when you visit the location and collect the stamps yourself.
Learn more about how to participate in a stamp rally here!
Pokémon: Pikachu

▸ LEGO Pokémon SMART Play
From August 3 to September 30, 2026, Trainers are invited to enter LEGO Stores in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia to visit in-store Trainer Centers and participate in the LEGO Pokémon SMART Play demo. Participants will receive a unique collectible SMART Play Tag and a special stamp for their LEGO Passports. Smart Tags are available while stocks last.
…

━━ RAIDS ━━
The following Pokémon will appear more frequently in raids at participating LEGO Store locations. You may encounter one with a Special Background!
These raids are local only—Remote Raid Passes cannot be used. Trainers can participate in one raid per day per store.

▸ Appearing in 1-Star Raids
Pokémon: Pikachu

━━ RESEARCH ━━
Free Timed Research will be available to Trainers who visit a LEGO Store during the event! Complete the research tasks to earn event stickers, the 2026 LEGO® Pokémon Jacket, and more.
Redeem promo code LEGOxPOKEMONGOxCAP to unlock Bonus Timed Research. The Cap Timed Research is only available in select countries, including but not exclusive to the ones mentioned with participating LEGO Stores. Trainers in countries that are not included will get Timed Research that rewards a Lucky Egg instead.
Trainers outside the Cap Timed Research countries receive this Timed Research instead.

▸ Possible workaround
Some Trainers have reported being able to receive the Cap Timed Research with these steps:
• Turn off location/GPS on your phone, then launch Pokémon GO.
• Open the Research tab.
• Close the game.
• Turn on location/GPS, open the game again, and the Cap Timed Research should be there.

Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, October 8, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following rewards.
• Encounter with Latios*
• Rare Candy XL
• Premium Battle Pass
• Lucky Egg
• And even more goodies!
Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.
• One Timed Incubator
• One Super Incubator
• Additional encounters with even more Pokémon!
• And even more goodies!

▸ Major Milestone Bonuses

▸ Tier 1 – Rank 1
• One additional Candy for trading Pokémon
• Trainers level 31 and above will receive one guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon

▸ Tier 2 – Rank 25
• Open up to 40 Gifts per day

• Hold 10 more Gifts in your Item Bag

▸ Tier 3 – Rank 50
• 2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

▸ Tier 4 – Rank 75

━━ GO PASS ━━
Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks or the various accomplishments listed here. Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.
Trainers will also have access to Weekly Tasks to earn points and increase their rank. The Weekly Tasks are as follows:
• Catch 75 Pokémon - 200 PTS
• Win a raid - 150 PTS
• Make 20 Great Throws - 150 PTS
• Hatch 3 Eggs - 150 PTS
• Spin 25 PokéStops or Gyms - 100 PTS
• Use 20 Berries to help catch Pokémon - 100 PTS
• Earn 10 hearts with your buddy - 150 PTS
There is also a daily task:
GO Pass: September Daily
• Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS
GO Pass Deluxe: September Daily
• Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS
Trainers can earn up to 250 extra points daily by completing certain tasks.
• Win a raid - 100 PTS
• Hatch an Egg - 40 PTS

Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails!
In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

━━ BONUSES ━━
▸ GO Pass Major Milestone Bonuses
Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses. Once unlocked, these bonuses will last until the current GO Pass ends!

▸ Rank 1
• One guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon for Trainers level 31 and above
• One additional Candy for trading Pokémon

▸ Rank 25
• Increased limits on opening Gifts, receiving Gifts from PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts

▸ Rank 50
• 2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

▸ Rank 75
• Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Pokémon Debuts
More Pokémon originally discovered in the Paldea region, which was featured in the Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet games for Nintendo Switch, have been spotted in Pokémon GO!
Be on the lookout for Maschiff, Mabosstiff, and more!
Pokémon: Maschiff, Mabosstiff

▸ Mega-Evolved Pokémon
Where Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale ends, a new trail begins! Gather ‘round for the Mega Evolution debuts of Staraptor, Chandelure, and more during Twilight Trails.
Stay tuned for more details on how to continue your Mega Evolution journey with the Mega Squads event, September Community Day Classic, and more!

▸ Max Pokémon Debuts
Dynamax Rhyhorn, Dynamax Sneasel, Dynamax Sizzlipede, and more will make their way into Max Battles throughout the Season. Keep an eye out for new Dynamax Pokémon at Power Spots!
Dynamax Uxie, Dynamax Mesprit, and Dynamax Azelf will appear in a Max Battle Day during Twilight Trails.
Pokémon: Rhyhorn, Sneasel, Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf, Sizzlipede

▸ Daily Discoveries
Throughout Twilight Trails, different days of the week will include a Daily Discovery experience. These will be active between 12:00 a.m. and 11:59 p.m. local time unless otherwise stated. Daily Discoveries may change as Scopely Explore experiments with how to make the best experience.
Please note: Daily Discoveries will not be available during the week of global GO Fest, GO Wild Area, and GO Tour events.

▸ Community Days
Mark your calendar! Twilight Trails will have Community Day events on the following dates.
• September 12 — September Community Day Classic
• October 10 — October Community Day
• November 21 — November Community Day

▸ GO Pass
GO Pass, a limited-time progression track, will be available during Twilight Trails! Complete Pass Tasks to earn GO Points to increase your rank and earn rewards.
The GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass, will be available for Trainers looking for upgraded rewards and faster progression.

pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-sendai-japan@p.summary: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Sendai • Tohoku
pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-sendai-japan@p.details:
GO Wild Area returns in 2026 with Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon, the debuts of Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia, and powerful mighty Pokémon. Collect GO Safari Balls to help catch these challenging encounters!
Dates: November 6, 7, or 8, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. JST (UTC+9) Location: Sendai, Japan, with gameplay throughout Miyagi Prefecture Ticket: ¥4,000 (including applicable taxes and fees) for one day
All event gameplay is exclusive to ticket holders. A standard ticket covers one selected day; Extra Day add-ons extend eligible gameplay to additional days. Gameplay is available only within the event area at the date and time specified on your ticket.
Ticket registration: Register from September 11 at 8:00 a.m. JST through September 15, 2026, at 7:59 a.m. JST. Registered Trainers will be notified of their purchase window afterward. Tickets are first come, first served, and registration does not guarantee availability. Read the ticket registration announcement.

▸ Related Events

━━ BONUSES ━━
▸ Ticket Holder Bonuses
The following bonuses apply from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time on your ticketed event day.
• Increased chance to encounter Shiny Pokémon
• 1/2 Hatch Distance for Eggs placed in Incubators during the event
• Up to 10 free Raid Passes per day from Gyms
• 3/4 Max Particle cost for unlocking and powering up Max Moves
• Daily Max Particle collection limit increased to 8,000
• Increased Max Particles from Power Spots and exploration
• Increased chance of 10 km Eggs from PokéStops and Gyms
• Lure Modules last for 2 hours
• Incense, excluding Daily Adventure Incense, lasts for 2 hours
• 2× Candy for catching Pokémon
• Party Play lasts for 8 hours
• Chance to encounter mighty Pokémon on Routes
• 3 GO Snapshot surprise encounters per day
• Chance to get GO Safari Balls from PokéStops and Gyms

▸ Trading Bonuses
Ticket holders receive these benefits from 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. local time on their ticketed event day.
• Up to 6 Special Trades per day
• 1/2 Stardust cost for trades
Shiny encounters are not guaranteed. To use the increased exploration Max Particle bonus, first collect all available Max Particles in the Nearby menu. Adventure Sync can help track exploration distance.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia
Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia make their Pokémon GO debuts during GO Wild Area 2026. Both can be Shiny!
Both Pokémon will appear in Max Battles during the in-person event.

▸ Machamp Wearing a Modern Jacket
A new costumed Machamp appears in three-star raids during the event. Lucky Trainers may encounter a Shiny one! Ticket holders can also encounter this Machamp as a mighty Pokémon in the wild.

▸ Hisuian Sliggoo and Hisuian Goodra Debut
Hisuian Sliggoo and Hisuian Goodra debut at the in-person GO Wild Area events. Ticket holders may find Hisuian Sliggoo in the wild during either habitat hour, including its Shiny form.
Use 100 Goomy Candy to evolve Hisuian Sliggoo into Hisuian Goodra.
Pokémon: Hisuian Sliggoo, Hisuian Goodra

▸ Mighty Latias and Latios
Ticket holders may attract mighty Latias and Latios with Incense, excluding Daily Adventure Incense, on their ticketed event day. Both can be Shiny and are quick to flee, so keep GO Safari Balls ready.

▸ GO Safari Balls
GO Safari Balls improve the chance of catching Pokémon, especially mighty Pokémon. Ticket holders can obtain them by spinning PokéStops and Gym Photo Discs during event hours.
They can only be used from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time on event days and become inaccessible after the event ends.

▸ Supply Balloons
Ticket holders receive hourly Supply Balloons with GO Safari Balls during event hours.

▸ GO Snapshot, Routes, and Party Play
Take snapshots for surprise encounters with Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon. Explore Routes for a chance to find mighty Pokémon, and enjoy Party Play sessions lasting eight hours.

▸ In-Person Experiences
Gameplay extends throughout Miyagi Prefecture, with in-person activities centered in Sendai.

▸ Pop-Ups and Photo Opportunities
Visit event pop-ups to meet other Trainers and enjoy themed photo opportunities. Exact pop-up locations will be announced later.

▸ Community Hub
…

━━ SPAWNS ━━
▸ Rotating Habitat Hours
Steel- and Dragon-themed encounters rotate hourly from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. throughout the event area on your ticketed day.
